Here’s a focused 2-week travel maintenance plan designed to preserve muscle, movement quality, and training rhythm while your client is limited to a hotel room, yoga mat, and door pull-up bar. She’s 6 weeks into a 12-week hypertrophy block; this plan holds strength/size with strategic tension, near-failure work, density, and adequate protein—without excessive fatigue. The structure assumes 5 training days/week with 2 recovery days. Sessions are 35–50 minutes. Emphasis: full-body frequency (upper pull bias because of bar), unilateral lower work, tempo and long eccentrics, short rests, and last-set near-failure to keep stimulus high with low load.

Global programming notes
- Frequency: 5 days/week (2 upper emphasis, 2 lower emphasis, 1 full-body “density/flow”), 2 active recovery days.
- Intensity prescription: Most sets RIR 2–3; last set of each exercise RIR 0–1 (stop when form deteriorates). If reps exceed target by >3 at RIR 1 for 2 sessions in a row, progress the variation (harder leverage) or add slow eccentrics/pauses.
- Tempo: Default 3–1–1 (3-sec eccentric, 1-sec pause, controlled up) unless noted.
- Rest: 45–75 sec for accessories; 90 sec for large compound bodyweight moves.
- Progression across weeks: Increase reps within the range, add a pause, or more difficult leverage. Maintain total weekly volume; don’t chase fatigue.
- Warm-up (5–7 min each session): 1–2 minutes brisk marching/jumping jacks; dynamic flow: world’s greatest stretch x4/side, cat-cow x8, scapular pull-ups x10, air squats x12 with 2-sec pause.
- Cool-down (3–5 min): Box breathing 3×5 breaths; light hip flexor stretch 45 sec/side; doorway pec stretch 45 sec/side.

Weekly structure overview
- Week 1: Establish strong contractions, controlled eccentrics, and density. Sessions A–E.
- Week 2: Slight progression via added reps/pauses/tempo/leverage. Same sessions with small upgrades.

Daily mobility “mini”: 3–5 minutes morning or evening—90/90 hip switches 1 min, thoracic open books 1 min/side, deep squat hold with prying 60–90 sec.

Week 1
Day 1 (Upper Emphasis A)
1) Pull-up or Assisted Eccentric Pull-up
- Option A: Full pull-ups 4×AMRAP to RIR 1–2, 90 sec rest
- Option B: Eccentric-only: jump/top hold then 4-sec lower, 5–6 reps ×4 sets, 90 sec
2) Pike/Decline Push-up (feet on bed or chair) 3×8–12, last set RIR 0–1
3) Doorframe Row (using towel around bar for neutral grip if needed) 4×10–15
4) Archer Push-up or Wide-Grip Push-up 3×6–10/side or total
5) Hollow Body Hold 3×25–40 sec
Finisher: 6–8 min EMOM
- Odd: Chin-over-bar hold 15–25 sec (or scap pull-ups ×8–10)
- Even: Diamond push-ups ×8–12

Day 2 (Lower Emphasis A)
1) Rear-Foot-Elevated Split Squat (rear foot on bed/chair) 4×8–12/leg, 3–1–2 tempo
2) Single-Leg Hip Thrust (shoulders on bed) 4×10–15/leg, 2-sec top squeeze
3) Cossack Squat 3×8–10/side
4) Skater Squat to target or Assisted Pistol to box 3×6–8/leg
5) Copenhagen Side Plank (top knee on bed edge) 3×20–30 sec/side
Optional density: 6 min AMRAP—Reverse lunge bodyweight x10/leg + Glute bridge ISO 30 sec

Day 3 (Active Recovery / Mobility + Light Conditioning)
- 20–30 min brisk walk or hotel stairs
- Mobility flow on mat (8–10 min): ankle rocks, hip airplanes, thread-the-needle, deep squat breathing, couch stretch
- Optional core: Dead bug 3×8/side, Side plank 3×30–40 sec/side

Day 4 (Upper Emphasis B)
1) Chin-up Cluster Sets: 5×(max reps to RIR 1), 60–75 sec between mini-sets
2) Feet-Elevated Push-up (hands on floor, feet on bed) 4×8–12, 2-sec pause at bottom on last 2 sets
3) Inverted Row from Door Bar (knees bent for easier, straight legs harder) 4×8–12
4) Handstand Hold Facing Wall or Pike Shoulder Tap 4×20–35 sec hold or 3×6–10 taps/side
5) Biceps: Supinated Isometric Curl with Towel (stand on towel) 3×20–30 sec mid-range
6) Triceps: Narrow Push-up Eccentric 3×6 with 4-sec lowers
Finisher: 3 rounds—Push-up 12, Row 12, Hollow rock 20 sec, 60 sec rest

Day 5 (Lower Emphasis B)
1) Tempo Squat (heels elevated on towel if needed) 4×12–15 with 4-sec eccentric + 1-sec pause
2) Split-Squat Pulse Set 3×10 full + 10 pulses/leg
3) Single-Leg Romanian Deadlift (bodyweight reach) 4×10–12/leg, 3-sec eccentric
4) Hip Airplane (counter support) 3×5/side
5) Calf Raises off step/rolled towel 4×12–20 with 2-sec pause at stretch
Core finisher: RKC Plank 3×20–30 sec + Dead bug 2×8/side

Day 6 (Full-Body Density/Flow)
Circuit, 4–5 rounds, 60–75 sec between rounds
- Pull-ups or Eccentrics 5–8 reps
- Push-ups 12–15 (vary grip each round)
- Walking lunge 12–16/leg
- Door row 12–15
- Bear crawl forward/back 20–30 steps
Optional: Add 30–60 sec jump rope simulation or high knees between rounds

Day 7 (Off)
- Gentle walk, stretch 10 minutes, hydration emphasis

Week 2
Progression guidance: Keep weekly volume similar. Increase difficulty by small leverage changes, added pauses, or slightly higher reps while staying shy of failure until last set.

Day 1 (Upper Emphasis A—Progressed)
1) Pull-up: add 2–3 total reps across session or 2-sec top hold each rep; 4×AMRAP to RIR 1
2) Pike/Decline Push-up: add 1–2 reps/set or 1-sec bottom pause; 3×9–13
3) Doorframe Row: feet a bit further forward for harder angle; 4×11–16
4) Archer Push-up: aim +1 rep/side; 3×7–11/side
5) Hollow Body: 3×30–45 sec
EMOM 6–8 min unchanged but try +2–3 sec on holds or +1–2 reps

Day 2 (Lower Emphasis A—Progressed)
1) RFESS: add 1–2 reps/set or a 2-sec bottom pause on first 6 reps; 4×9–13/leg
2) Single-Leg Hip Thrust: add extended top pause to 3 sec; 4×10–16
3) Cossack: deepen range; 3×9–11/side
4) Skater Squat/Pistol: aim +1 rep/leg; 3×7–9
5) Copenhagen: +5–10 sec/side
Optional AMRAP: same 6 min but increase reverse lunge to 12/leg

Day 3 (Active Recovery)
- 25–35 min easy cardio
- Mobility flow; add thoracic extension over towel roll; breathwork 3–4 min

Day 4 (Upper Emphasis B—Progressed)
1) Chin-up Clusters: add one additional mini-set or +1 rep per set; keep RIR 1
2) Feet-Elevated Push-up: pause 2 sec at bottom on all working sets; 4×9–13
3) Inverted Row: feet slightly elevated if safe; 4×9–13
4) Handstand Hold/Pike Taps: +5–10 sec or +1–2 taps/side
5) Biceps Isometric: +5 sec/set
6) Triceps Eccentric: 3×7 with 4-sec lowers
Finisher: Try to reduce total time by ~10% keeping form

Day 5 (Lower Emphasis B—Progressed)
1) Tempo Squat: 4×13–16, maintain 4-sec eccentric + 1-sec pause
2) Split-Squat Pulse: 3×12 full + 10–12 pulses
3) Single-Leg RDL reach: 4×11–13/leg; add 1-sec isometric mid-shin
4) Hip Airplane: 3×6/side
5) Calf Raises: 4×15–22 with 3-sec stretch pause
Core finisher unchanged, aim +5–10 sec on RKC planks

Day 6 (Full-Body Density/Flow—Progressed)
- Same circuit 4–5 rounds; try to finish one round faster or add 1 more rep per station
- Optionally add a 20–30 sec isometric: squat hold or top-of-pull-up hang at end of round

Day 7 (Off)
- Easy walk, light stretch, extra sleep

Nutrition and recovery guidelines (maintenance-focused)
- Calories: Aim at current maintenance. If uncertain and eating out, use “anchor meals” with protein and veg, keep starch/fat moderate. If scale trends down >0.5% BW for 5–7 days, increase by ~150–200 kcal/day; if up, trim by 100–150 kcal/day.
- Protein: 1.6–2.2 g/kg/day, prioritize 3–4 feedings with 25–40 g high-quality protein each (Greek yogurt, eggs, lean meats, tofu/tempeh, whey if available).
- Carbs: Around training windows for energy; fruit + simple starch pre or post if sessions feel flat.
- Hydration: 30–40 ml/kg/day; add 500–750 ml on hot travel days. Include electrolytes if sweating heavily.
- Fiber/micros: Aim 5+ servings veg/fruit daily; add a simple multivitamin if travel diet is inconsistent.
- Alcohol: Keep to minimal; dehydration and recovery hit is disproportionate.
- Sleep: Target 7–9 hours. If jet-lagged: morning light exposure, 10–15 min walk after waking, limit late caffeine, consider 0.5–1 mg melatonin short-term.
- Soreness management: Keep RIR honest, avoid grinding. If overly sore, drop one set per exercise that day.

Safety and setup tips for hotel environments
- Door pull-up bar: Ensure door is sturdy; test with controlled hangs first. Use a towel on jambs for stability and to protect surfaces.
- Floor: Use yoga mat on carpet/tile for traction in push-ups and pike work.
- Chairs/bed: Check stability before using for feet-elevated work.

- Pull-up snapshot (1 top set to RIR 1): aim within ±1 rep of baseline or +1 by Week 2.
- Session completion rate: target ≥85–90%.
- Standardized finisher (e.g., Day 4 AMRAP): within ±1 round of Week 1 or slight improvement.
- 3-day morning weight average: within ±0.5% of pre-trip baseline.
- Protein anchors: ≥20 meals/week with 25–40 g protein.

Here’s the complete 2-week travel maintenance program consolidated with all adjustments: bodyweight-only (yoga mat + door pull-up bar), 5 training days, 2 active recovery days, 15-minute cardio finishers on training days, an active rest option for fatigue, and a slightly harder Week 2 to feel progress. Sessions run ~35–50 minutes plus the 15-minute finisher.

Global programming notes
- Frequency: 5 training days/week (Upper A, Lower A, Active Recovery, Upper B, Lower B, Full-Body), 2 recovery days.
- Intensity: Most sets RIR 2–3; last set per exercise RIR 0–1 (stop when form degrades).
- Tempo: Default 3–1–1 unless noted.
- Rest: 45–75 sec for accessories; 90 sec for larger bodyweight compounds.
- Progression: Week 2 uses small leverage/tempo upgrades, one “plus set” per day, and modest volume bumps where noted.
- Warm-up (5–7 min each session): 1–2 min brisk marching or jumping jacks; world’s greatest stretch x4/side; cat-cow x8; scapular pull-ups x10; air squats x12 with 2-sec pause.
- Cool-down (3–5 min): Box breathing 3×5 breaths; hip flexor stretch 45 sec/side; doorway pec stretch 45 sec/side.
- Safety: Verify door bar stability; use towel on jambs; test with controlled hang. Use mat for traction.

WEEK 1
Day 1 — Upper Emphasis A
Strength
1) Pull-up or Assisted Eccentric Pull-up
- Option A: Full pull-ups 4×AMRAP to RIR 1–2, 90 sec rest
- Option B: Eccentric-only: jump/top hold then 4-sec lower, 5–6 reps ×4 sets
2) Pike/Decline Push-up (feet on bed or chair) 3×8–12, last set to RIR 0–1
3) Doorframe/Inverted Row (neutral grip with towel if needed) 4×10–15
4) Archer Push-up or Wide-Grip Push-up 3×6–10/side or total
5) Hollow Body Hold 3×25–40 sec
Finisher (15:00) — Pull-Push Aerobic Power EMOM
- Min 1: Pull-up variation 4–6 reps (or 8–10 scap pull-ups) + fast mountain climbers to 40–50 reps total
- Min 2: Push-ups 10–15 + high knees 20–30/side
- Min 3: Alternating reverse lunge 10–12/leg
Repeat 5 rounds

Day 2 — Lower Emphasis A
Strength
1) Rear-Foot-Elevated Split Squat 4×8–12/leg, 3–1–2 tempo
2) Single-Leg Hip Thrust (shoulders on bed) 4×10–15/leg, 2-sec top squeeze
3) Cossack Squat 3×8–10/side
4) Skater Squat to target or Assisted Pistol to box 3×6–8/leg
5) Copenhagen Side Plank (top knee on bed edge) 3×20–30 sec/side
Optional density: 6 min AMRAP—Reverse lunge x10/leg + Glute bridge ISO 30 sec
Finisher (15:00) — 30/15 Mixed Intervals
- 30 sec work / 15 sec swap, cycle 6 moves for 15 minutes:
1) Skater step-throughs
2) Fast bodyweight hip thrusts (2-sec squeeze)
3) Lateral shuffle or side step-overs
4) Split-squat switches (or step-backs for low impact)
5) Bear crawl forward/back on mat
6) Plank shoulder taps

Day 3 — Active Recovery
- 20–30 min brisk walk or hotel stairs
- Mobility flow (8–10 min): ankle rocks, hip airplanes, thread-the-needle, deep squat breathing, couch stretch
- Optional core: Dead bug 3×8/side; Side plank 3×30–40 sec/side
- Optional finisher (easy aerobic flush 15:00 continuous): march, easy step-back lunges, calf raises, in-room pacing; conversational pace

Day 4 — Upper Emphasis B
Strength
1) Chin-up Cluster Sets: 5×(max reps to RIR 1), 60–75 sec between mini-sets
2) Feet-Elevated Push-up 4×8–12; add 2-sec pause at bottom on last 2 sets
3) Inverted Row from Door Bar (knees bent easier; straight legs harder) 4×8–12
4) Handstand Hold Facing Wall or Pike Shoulder Tap 4×20–35 sec hold or 3×6–10 taps/side
5) Biceps: Supinated Isometric Curl with Towel (stand on towel) 3×20–30 sec mid-range
6) Triceps: Narrow Push-up Eccentric 3×6 with 4-sec lowers
Finisher (15:00) — Upper Density AMRAP
- 3 pull-ups (or 5-sec chin-over-bar hold + 3 slow lowers)
- 10 feet-elevated push-ups (or standard)
- 12 door rows
- 20-sec hollow rock
- 20 jumping jacks (or silent jacks)
Loop for quality rounds at RPE ~7.5

Active rest substitute for this day (if tired)
- 20–30 minutes at RPE 4–5: breath reset 2–3 min; mobility circuit (cat-cow, thread-the-needle, 90/90, world’s greatest, deep squat hold); 8–12 min easy aerobic loop (march, step-backs, calf raises, slow bear crawl); core (dead bug, side plank); brief downshift breathing. Resume Day 5 as planned.

Day 5 — Lower Emphasis B
Strength
1) Tempo Squat (heels elevated on towel if needed) 4×12–15 with 4-sec eccentric + 1-sec pause
2) Split-Squat Pulse Set 3×10 full + 10 pulses/leg
3) Single-Leg Romanian Deadlift (reach) 4×10–12/leg, 3-sec eccentric
4) Hip Airplane (counter support) 3×5/side
5) Calf Raises off step/rolled towel 4×12–20 with 2-sec stretch pause
Core finisher: RKC Plank 3×20–30 sec + Dead bug 2×8/side
Finisher (15:00) — Lower EMOM
- Min 1: Tempo squats 12–15 (3-sec down, 1-sec pause) + 10 calf raises
- Min 2: Alternating walking lunges 12–14/leg
- Min 3: Glute bridge hold 30–40 sec + brisk march
Repeat 5 rounds

Day 6 — Full-Body Density/Flow
Strength Circuit, 4–5 rounds, 60–75 sec between rounds
- Pull-ups or Eccentrics 5–8
- Push-ups 12–15 (vary grip each round)
- Walking lunge 12–16/leg
- Door row 12–15
- Bear crawl forward/back 20–30 steps
Finisher (15:00) — Ascending Ladder
- 1-2-3-4-5-6… of:
1) Pull-ups or eccentric lowers
2) Push-ups
3) Alternating reverse lunge per leg
Between rungs: 20–30 sec bear crawl or plank walk-out; keep moving

Day 7 — Off
- Gentle walk, 10-minute stretch, hydration emphasis

WEEK 2 (progressed for confidence; includes “plus sets” and slight volume bumps)
Day 1 — Upper Emphasis A (Progressed+)
Strength
1) Pull-up: 5×AMRAP to RIR 1–2 (add 1 total set)
- Plus set: After last set, chin-over-bar hold 20–30 sec (break as needed)
2) Pike/Decline Push-up: 3×9–13 with 1–2 sec bottom pause on all reps
3) Doorframe/Inverted Row (harder angle): 4×12–16
- Final set drop: move feet forward for 6–8 challenging reps, then step back and continue to near-failure with good form
4) Archer Push-up: 3×7–11/side with 2-sec isometric at stretched bottom on first 5 reps
5) Hollow Body Hold: 3×30–45 sec (start full, then scale)
Finisher (15:00) — EMOM progression
- Same as Week 1, aim +1 rep per station across the 5 rounds

Day 2 — Lower Emphasis A (Progressed+)
Strength
1) Rear-Foot-Elevated Split Squat: 5×9–13/leg (add 1 set), 3–1–2 tempo
- Last set AMRAP to RIR 0–1
2) Single-Leg Hip Thrust: 4×10–16, 3-sec top squeeze
- After final rep last set: 10-sec iso hold at top
3) Cossack Squat: 3×9–11/side; 1-sec pause in deepest stable range
4) Skater Squat or Assisted Pistol: 3×7–9/leg; 4-sec eccentric
5) Copenhagen Side Plank: 3×25–40 sec/side; add 5 pulses at top each set
Finisher (15:00) — 40/20 Mixed Intervals
- Same six moves; slightly higher output than Week 1; nasal breathing first 6 minutes if possible

Day 3 — Active Recovery
- 25–35 min easy cardio
- Mobility flow; add thoracic extension over towel roll; breathwork 3–4 min
- Optional confidence touch: easy scapular pull-ups x12 + easy push-ups x10 (RIR ≥4)

Day 4 — Upper Emphasis B (Progressed+)
Strength
1) Chin-up Clusters: Add one mini-set (e.g., 6 total) staying at RIR 1 per cluster
- Plus set: 1×3–4 eccentric-only reps with 4–5 sec lowers
2) Feet-Elevated Push-up: 4×9–13 with 2-sec bottom pause on all sets
3) Inverted Row: 4×9–13; elevate feet slightly if safe; last rep each set = 10-sec mid-range iso
4) Handstand Hold or Pike Shoulder Taps: 4×25–40 sec hold or 3×7–11 taps/side
5) Biceps Isometric (Towel Curl): 3×25–35 sec; slow 3-sec ramp-up and ramp-down
6) Triceps Eccentric Narrow Push-up: 3×7 with 4-sec lowers
Finisher (15:00) — AMRAP progression
- Same loop; aim +1 rep per exercise per round, or finish total work 30–45 sec faster with equal form

Day 5 — Lower Emphasis B (Progressed+)
Strength
1) Tempo Squat: 4×13–16 with 4-sec eccentric + 2-sec bottom pause
2) Split-Squat Pulse Set: 3×12 full + 12 pulses/leg
3) Single-Leg RDL Reach: 4×11–13/leg with 1-sec mid-shin iso each rep
4) Hip Airplane: 3×6/side with 2-sec holds in open/closed positions
5) Calf Raises: 5×15–22 (add 1 set); last set includes 3-sec stretch pause at bottom and 2-sec squeeze at top
Core finisher: RKC Plank 3×25–35 sec + Dead bug 2×8–10/side
Finisher (15:00) — EMOM progression
- Min 1: Tempo squats 13–16 + 12 calf raises
- Min 2: Walking lunges 14–16/leg
- Min 3: Glute bridge hold 35–45 sec + brisk march
Repeat 5 rounds

Day 6 — Full-Body Density/Flow (Progressed+)
Strength Circuit, 5 rounds (if Week 1 was 4), 60–75 sec between rounds
- Pull-ups or Eccentrics 5–8
- Push-ups 12–16
- Walking lunge 14–18/leg
- Door row 12–15
- Bear crawl 25–35 steps
Plus set: Max bar hang 20–40 sec (or 2×15–20 sec) at the end for grip/lats
Finisher (15:00) — Descending Ladder
- 6-5-4-3-2-1 of:
1) Pull-ups or eccentrics
2) Push-ups x2 (if pull-ups are 6, do 12 push-ups)
3) Reverse lunges per leg
Between rungs: 20–30 sec bear crawl or plank walk-out; if finished early, restart at 1s

Day 7 — Off
- Easy walk, light stretch, extra sleep

Nutrition and recovery (travel-simple)
- Calories: Aim at maintenance. If weight trends down >0.5% BW over 5–7 days, add ~150–200 kcal/day; if up, trim 100–150 kcal/day.
- Protein: 1.6–2.2 g/kg/day; 3–4 meals with 25–40 g each. Restaurant anchors: grilled protein + 1–2 veg sides; add rice/potato if hungry or after training.
- Carbs: Around training windows for energy; fruit or simple starch pre/post if sessions feel flat.
- Hydration: 30–40 ml/kg/day; +500–750 ml on training/hot days; consider electrolytes.
- Sleep: Target 7–9 hours; morning light and short walks to aid jet lag.
- Soreness/fatigue adjustments: If RPE >8.5 or soreness lingers >48 h, remove the day’s “plus set” and/or drop one set per main exercise; skip the finisher that day.

Simple weekly “hold” metrics
- Pull-up snapshot (1 top set to RIR 1): aim within ±1 rep of baseline or +1 by Week 2.
- Session completion rate: target ≥85–90%.
- Standardized finisher (e.g., Day 4 AMRAP): within ±1 round of Week 1 or slight improvement.
- 3-day morning weight average: within ±0.5% of pre-trip baseline.
- Protein anchors: ≥20 meals/week with 25–40 g protein.

This plan preserves muscle and movement quality with smart intensity, keeps conditioning sharp with 15-minute finishers, offers a gentle off-ramp on tired days, and adds just enough Week 2 challenge to feel like true progress while traveling.
